fields.statement: At 49cf7e8ad ran go test -trimpath ./internal/guide -run 'Review|Plan' -v: all pass, including TestReviewSeverityBlockShared, which asserts the review and plan-review '## Severities' blocks are byte-identical, that the block names no go/Go/make/rhiza check/render/ship/testscript, and that both Critic sections contain confirmed, downgraded, dropped and 'Never add a finding'.
